Safety and convenience features include dual front impact airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, and low tire pressure warning. The backup camera with rear parking sensors makes maneuvering simpler and safer. Speed-sensing power steering and an independent front suspension contribute to responsive handling.

At 93,316 miles, this F-150 XL is a well-maintained truck ready for its next owner. Whether you're a contractor needing reliable transportation or someone seeking a practical daily driver with truck versatility, this vehicle offers proven Ford dependability and capability.

We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience the quality and performance of this F-150 XL firsthand. Our team is ready to answer your questions and help you find your next vehicle.

Meet this 2015 Toyota Sienna XLE, a reliable family vehicle ready to serve your transportation needs with capability and comfort. This blue minivan combines practical design with features that make daily driving more enjoyable, whether you're managing a busy household or taking longer trips.

- Heated leather seats
- 3.5L V6 engine with strong acceleration
- Backup camera
- Bluetooth connectivity
- Power moonroof
- 17 premium alloy wheels
- Power liftgate
- Front and rear dual zone climate control
- Heated front seats
- Reclining third row seat
- Split folding rear seat
- HomeLink garage door transmitter
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror
- 6-speaker AM/FM/HD radio with SiriusXM

The heart of this Sienna is its 3.5L V6 engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission, delivering the kind of responsive performance you'll appreciate during highway merges and daily driving. This powertrain achieves 18 MPG in the city and 25 MPG on the highway, balancing capability with reasonable fuel efficiency.

Inside, the XLE trim prioritizes comfort and convenience. Heated leather front seats keep passengers warm during cold weather, while the automatic dual zone climate control lets driver and front passenger set their preferred temperatures independently. The rear air conditioning extends comfort to back-seat passengers, and the power moonroof adds light and open-air feel to the cabin. Electronic temperature controls and rear window defroster handle seasonal demands efficiently.

Connectivity and entertainment are well covered. The audio system includes AM/FM/HD radio with SiriusXM capability, a CD player, and Bluetooth integration so you can stream music and handle calls hands-free. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your focus on the road. The backup camera and exterior parking camera provide visibility assistance when maneuvering, while HomeLink lets you operate your garage door from the driver's seat.

The three-row seating arrangement offers flexibility for passengers and cargo. The second-row seats feature power adjustment for driver convenience, while the third-row seat reclines for added comfort and the split folding rear seat adapts to your carrying needs. The power liftgate makes loading and unloading easier, especially when your hands are full.

Safety and control features include electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, brake assist, and a comprehensive airbag system with dual front impact, front side impact, knee, and overhead airbags. Speed-sensing steering and front and rear anti-roll bars contribute to composed handling.

This Sienna XLE represents solid family transportation with the features that matter for comfortable, capable driving. Visit our showroom to see it in person and take it for a test drive.

Climate control features, including the engine block heater and de-icer system, demonstrate this vehicle's readiness for challenging weather. description:
This 2024 Toyota Tundra Hybrid Platinum delivers the capability you need with the efficiency that makes sense for today's driving demands.

- Hybrid powertrain with 3.4L V6 engine and 10-speed automatic transmission
- 4WD system for confident handling in all conditions
- Tow package for serious hauling capability
- Leather seating with heated and ventilated front seats
- Power running boards and power deck step with step cover
- Navigation system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Premium audio system with 12 speakers and JBL technology
- SiriusXM satellite radio
- Back-up camera for enhanced safety and convenience
- Power moonroof for open-air driving
- 20-inch dark-painted alloy wheels
- Heated steering wheel and heated rear seats
- Safety Connect emergency communication system with 10-year trial
- Auto high-beam headlights and front fog lights
- Beige exterior with special color finish

The Platinum trim positions this truck as a refined choice for those who refuse to compromise between work capability and everyday comfort. Built on a foundation of serious towing capacity, this Tundra combines a fuel-efficient hybrid powertrain with the muscular presence drivers expect from Toyota's full-size offering. The 4WD system ensures you're ready for whatever terrain or weather comes your way.

Inside, the cabin reflects attention to detail with leather appointments throughout. Heated and ventilated front seats keep you comfortable whether temperatures drop or climb, while the heated steering wheel and heated rear seats extend that comfort to your entire family. The power moonroof frames the experience with natural light and fresh air when you want it.

Technology integrates seamlessly into your daily routine. The navigation system guides you with precision, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep your phone connected to the premium 12-speaker JBL audio system. SiriusXM satellite radio brings expansive entertainment options to every drive, and the back-up camera provides peace of mind when maneuvering in tight spaces.

Practical features work in concert with luxury appointments. Power running boards and the power deck step make entry and exit effortless, regardless of the truck's height. Rain-sensing wipers and auto high-beam headlights adjust to conditions automatically, so you focus on the road. The tow package stands ready for trailers and serious hauling.

This 2024 Tundra Hybrid Platinum represents a thoughtful investment in capability, comfort, and efficiency. We invite you to experience it firsthand and discover why this truck deserves a place in your future.

Pickup-box and cab-mounted cargo lighting help illuminate the bed after dark.

This 2019 Lexus IS 350 combines refined performance with sophisticated styling, offering a compelling choice for drivers who value both driving dynamics and premium comfort.

- F SPORT Package with tuned suspension and performance upgrades
- Navigation with Mark Levinson Premium Surround Sound Audio System
- Low & High Beam Twin Projector LED Headlamps
- 3.5L V6 DOHC Dual VVT-i Engine with 8-Speed Automatic Transmission
- F SPORT Perforated Leather Heated Steering Wheel with paddle shifters
- Intuitive Park Assist with clearance and rear sonar
- Heated & Ventilated Front F SPORT Seats with NuLuxe Trim
- Blind Spot Monitor with Cross Traffic Alert
- Power Moonroof
- Torsen Limited-Slip Differential
- Auto-dimming Rear-View Mirror
- Exterior Parking Camera
- HomeLink Garage Door Transmitter
- 18" F SPORT Split 5-Spoke Alloy Wheels

The F SPORT package elevates this IS 350 with purposeful design elements and performance enhancements. The specially tuned suspension provides responsive handling, while the unique front fascia, distinctive rear bumper, and F SPORT badging create a commanding presence. The LFA-inspired instrument cluster and aluminum sport pedals reinforce the sports-oriented character throughout the cabin.

Under the hood, the 3.5L V6 engine delivers capable performance paired with the smooth 8-Speed Automatic transmission, achieving 20 city and 28 highway MPG. The Torsen Limited-Slip Differential enhances traction and cornering stability, while the F SPORT tuned adaptive variable suspension adapts to your driving conditions for confident handling in any situation.

The interior showcases premium comfort and connectivity. The Mark Levinson audio system features 15 speakers and 835 watts of continuous power, delivering refined sound quality. The navigation system provides Lexus Enform Destinations with destination assist, complemented by integrated SiriusXM satellite radio with a complimentary 90-day trial subscription. The 10.3-inch touchscreen interface puts controls at your fingertips.

Safety features are comprehensive, including dual front impact airbags, side-impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags. Blind Spot Monitor with Cross Traffic Alert enhances awareness, while the Exterior Parking Camera and Intuitive Park Assist make maneuvering effortless. The Emergency Communication System provides added peace of mind.

This Red IS 350 has been well-maintained and represents an excellent opportunity to own a luxury performance sedan that delivers engaging driving dynamics without compromise. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the refinement and capability this vehicle offers.

Discover the exceptional capability and sophisticated design of this 2020 BMW X7 xDrive40i, a three-row luxury SUV that combines performance, comfort, and advanced technology in a package designed for discerning drivers.

- 5-Zone Automatic Climate Control
- Second-Row Captain's Chairs

- Rear Electric Side Window Shades
- Navigation System
- Apple CarPlay Compatibility
- Premium Package
- Heated Front Seats
- Power Moonroof
- 21 Y-Spoke Bi-Color Wheels

This gray sedan seats up to seven passengers with a thoughtfully designed interior that prioritizes both comfort and convenience. The second-row captain's chairs provide generous personal space, while the premium leather upholstery and genuine wood accents throughout the cabin create an atmosphere of refined elegance. Climate control extends to all five zones, allowing each passenger to adjust their surroundings independently.

The 3.0L inline-six engine paired with an eight-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive delivers capable performance while maintaining fuel efficiency with ratings of 20 city and 25 highway MPG. This powertrain provides the balance of responsive handling and smooth acceleration expected from BMW's engineering standards.

Advanced technology features enhance both driving pleasure and practical functionality. The head-up display keeps critical information in your line of sight, while gesture control allows you to manage select functions with intuitive hand movements. The harman/kardon surround sound system delivers premium audio quality, and the navigation system ensures you arrive at your destination with confidence. Remote engine start and soft-close automatic doors add layers of convenience to your daily experience.

Safety and visibility have been thoughtfully engineered into this vehicle. An exterior parking camera rear assists with maneuvering, while rain-sensing wipers and fully automatic headlights adapt to changing conditions. The comprehensive airbag system and electronic stability control work in concert to protect all occupants.

This BMW X7 represents a significant investment in quality and capability. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this luxury SUV firsthand and discuss how it can enhance your lifestyle and driving experience.

This 2026 Toyota Corolla Hybrid SE represents an excellent choice for drivers seeking reliability and fuel efficiency. Inside, the cabin reflects modern refinement with comfortable seating arrangements and intuitive technology integration. The 10.5-inch multimedia touchscreen offers seamless smartphone connectivity through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected while maintaining focus on the road. The Corolla Hybrid SE combines practicality with modern conveniences. Variably intermittent wipers, fully automatic headlights, and power windows enhance daily convenience, while the split folding rear seat expands cargo flexibility. The trip computer and outside temperature display provide useful driving information at a glance.

We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this 2026 Toyota Corolla Hybrid SE firsthand. Our team is ready to answer your questions and help you get behind the wheel of a vehicle that delivers reliability, efficiency, and the confidence that comes with Toyota certification.

Gettel's Got It!

This 2017 Chevrolet Tahoe LT delivers the commanding presence and capability you need for family adventures and daily driving. With a powerful EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine and smooth 6-speed automatic transmission, this full-size SUV provides the performance and control that comes standard with this class. The black exterior presents a sophisticated, professional appearance that turns heads while maintaining the durability you expect from Chevrolet's proven engineering.

- Power sunroof with express-open and close
- Chevrolet MyLink navigation system with 8-inch touchscreen and Apple CarPlay/Android Auto
- Heated leather-wrapped steering wheel
- Memory power tilt and telescopic steering column
- Second row power release 60/40 split folding bench seat
- Heated second row seats
- Power-folding third row 60/40 split bench seats
- Wireless charging device
- Hands-free power liftgate
- Front and rear parking assist with audible warning
- Rear cross-traffic alert and side blind zone alert
- Keyless start with passive entry system
- Heated, power-adjustable, power-folding mirrors
- 20-inch chrome wheels with all-season tires
- Chrome assist steps and recovery hooks

The luxurious interior welcomes you with leather-appointed seating throughout, offering comfort for all three rows. The enhanced audio system features a Bose premium 9-speaker setup with SiriusXM satellite radio and AM/FM tuning, keeping entertainment options available for every journey. Advanced climate control includes front dual-zone air conditioning and rear air conditioning with automatic temperature adjustment, ensuring comfort for every passenger regardless of row position.

Safety and convenience combine seamlessly with this Tahoe's extensive feature set. Forward collision alert, lane keep assist, and low-speed forward automatic braking provide active protection during daily driving. The OnStar basic plan covers five years of emergency communication and guidance, while automatic high-beam headlights and rain-sensing wipers adapt to your driving conditions. Remote vehicle start, push-button keyless entry, and the hands-free power liftgate add practical convenience to your daily routine.

The Tahoe LT rides on a premium smooth ride suspension package, delivering a composed driving experience whether you're navigating city streets or highway routes. With 16 MPG city and 23 MPG highway, this V8-powered platform balances capability with reasonable fuel economy. The rear 3.08 axle ratio optimizes performance across varying conditions, while electronic stability control and traction control maintain confidence in any weather.

Storage and flexibility define this vehicle's practical nature. Multiple 12-volt auxiliary power outlets keep devices charged throughout the cabin, while the navigation system includes NavTraffic capability to optimize your route. The split-folding second and third-row seating arrangements adapt to your cargo needs, and the roof rack side rails accommodate additional carrying capacity. This configuration transforms from passenger hauler to cargo carrier with straightforward adjustments.

We invite you to visit our showroom and experience this 2017 Chevrolet Tahoe LT firsthand. Schedule a test drive today to feel the commanding presence, responsive handling, and spacious accommodations that make this SUV a trusted choice for families and professionals alike.

This 2011 Honda CR-V EX-L offers reliable performance and practical utility for drivers seeking a dependable crossover vehicle.

The Silver exterior presents a clean, professional appearance that suits any setting. Inside, the leather shift knob, tilt and telescoping steering wheel, and overhead console with outside temperature display reflect thoughtful design.

Safety and control are priorities with this model. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and anti-whiplash front head restraints work to help keep you secure. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags provide comprehensive protection. Low tire pressure warning keeps you aware of tire condition.

The powertrain delivers steady performance with 21 city miles per gallon and 27 highway miles per gallon, making this crossover efficient for daily driving and longer trips alike. AWD provides additional traction and control in varying weather and road conditions.

Come experience this well-equipped CR-V EX-L and discover why it remains a practical choice for families and drivers who value reliability and thoughtful features.

description:
2012 Hyundai Sonata SE with 73,777 miles, finished in distinctive Sparkling Ruby Mica with a Black interior. This sporty midsize sedan combines efficient four-cylinder performance, sharp SE styling, a power sunroof, touchscreen navigation, premium audio, and a comfortable five-passenger cabin for drivers throughout Wesley Chapel, Tampa, Clearwater, St. Petersburg, and Brooksville.

Power comes from Hyundai s 2.4L DOHC 16-valve GDI four-cylinder engine with Dual Continuously Variable Valve Timing. It is paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission featuring overdrive and SHIFTRONIC manual-shift capability. Steering-wheel-mounted paddle shifters allow the driver to select gears manually when a more engaged driving experience is desired.

The front-wheel-drive platform provides predictable handling and efficient everyday operation. EPA estimates of 24 MPG city and 35 MPG highway make this Sonata well suited for commuting, highway travel, school transportation, and regular daily driving. The Active ECO system can adjust vehicle operation to support more economical driving.

As an SE model, this Sonata receives a sport-tuned suspension with MacPherson struts up front, an independent multi-link rear suspension, gas-pressurized shocks, and front and rear stabilizer bars. Engine-speed-sensitive power steering and four-wheel disc brakes contribute to responsive road manners and confident stopping performance.

Sparkling Ruby Mica gives the Sonata a rich, distinctive appearance. Exterior highlights include 18-inch Hyper Silver alloy wheels, P225/45R18 performance tires, projector-style headlights with automatic on-and-off operation, fog lights, a dark chrome grille, chrome hood garnish, chrome window trim, chrome-accented door handles, and dual exhaust outlets with chrome tips.

Heated body-color power mirrors include a timer function, while speed-sensitive variable intermittent windshield wipers adapt to changing driving conditions. Solar-control glass helps reduce heat entering the cabin, and the power tilt-and-slide sunroof brings additional light and fresh air into the interior.

Inside, the Black cabin features sport front bucket seats with an 8-way power-adjustable driver seat and power lumbar support. Active front head restraints, a leather-wrapped shift knob, metal-grain interior accents, leatherette door trim, and door-sill scuff plates reinforce the Sonata SE s sport-oriented design.

The rear seat uses a 60/40 split-folding layout, allowing the passenger compartment and trunk to accommodate longer items when needed. A rear center armrest with dual cupholders, seatback pockets, door bottle holders, a locking glovebox, dual-level center console, and multiple storage areas help keep the cabin organized.

The Navigation and Sunroof Package adds a high-resolution touchscreen navigation system, rearview camera, power sunroof, XM NavTraffic and NavWeather capability, an external amplifier, subwoofer, and Dimension premium speakers. The rearview camera provides additional visibility while backing into parking spaces or maneuvering in tighter areas.

Entertainment and connectivity features include Bluetooth phone integration with phonebook transfer, AM/FM/XM audio, CD and MP3 capability, iPod, USB, and auxiliary inputs, steering-wheel-mounted controls, and a shark-fin antenna. The upgraded audio system delivers stronger sound throughout the cabin than the standard six-speaker arrangement.

Additional conveniences include cruise control, air conditioning with a cabin air filter, power windows with driver one-touch operation and pinch protection, remote trunk and fuel-door releases, illuminated vanity mirrors, front map lights, cargo-area lighting, trip computer, outside information displays, and two center-console 12-volt power outlets.

The 4.3-inch display provides clear information at a glance, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your focus on the road.

Convenience features are thoughtfully integrated throughout. The Nissan Intelligent Key system with push button ignition eliminates fumbling with traditional keys, while the RearView Monitor provides added peace of mind when backing up. The Divide-N-Hide adjustable floor accommodates various cargo configurations, and the rear seat fold-down center armrest with cupholders offers flexible passenger comfort.

Safety and stability are paramount with dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, front and rear anti-roll bars, and electronic stability control working together to protect occupants. The front wheel independent suspension provides a composed ride quality, while low tire pressure warning ensures you're aware of tire condition.

This vehicle presents a solid opportunity for a buyer prioritizing affordability, efficiency, and dependable transportation backed by a strong service history.

description: The 2010 Toyota RAV4 V6 is special because it featured a massive 3.5-liter engine that produced an unprecedented 269 horsepower. This made the compact SUV surprisingly fast, rocketing from 0 to 60 mph in under 7 seconds, all while achieving fuel economy nearly identical to the weaker 4-cylinder engine.Outrageous Power-to-Weight RatioThe 2010 RAV4 V6 housed the legendary 3.5-liter 2GR-FE V6 engine, widely used across larger Toyota and Lexus sedans and crossovers. Pumping out 269 horsepower and 246 lb-ft of torque, it provided sports-car-like acceleration in a compact SUV frame. It is frequently considered "overkill" in the best way possible.Surprising Fuel EfficiencyDespite having nearly 100 more horsepower than the standard 4-cylinder engine, the V6 is incredibly efficient. The EPA fuel economy ratings for the V6 RAV4 sit at roughly 19 mpg city and 26 mpg highway (for the AWD version). This was only a 1 to 2 mpg difference from the 4-cylinder, making the V6 a no-brainer for performance-minded buyers.True 4WD LockIf you opted for the V6 with all-wheel drive, the vehicle included a true 4WD lock feature. Unlike many standard front-wheel-drive crossover competitors, pressing the "4WD Lock" button on the 2010 RAV4 fixes the front-to-rear power distribution at a 50/50 split, offering enhanced traction in snow, sand, or mud.The Sport Appearance PackageThe V6 could be paired with the Sport trim, which offered an exclusive Sport Appearance Package. This unique package removed the exterior spare tire from the rear tailgate, giving the SUV a much sleeker, more traditional crossover appearance. Models with this package came equipped with run-flat tires, a stainless steel exhaust tip, and chrome-accented interior trim

This stunning 2026 Chevrolet Tahoe Z71 in Radiant Red Tintcoat represents the pinnacle of full-size SUV capability and comfort. With just 7,159 miles and the remainder of the factory warranty still applies, this local trade-in offers an exceptional opportunity to own a premium three-row vehicle that delivers on every front.

- Second row power-release bucket seats with heated outboard seating
- Dual-pane power panoramic sunroof with express-open and close functionality
- Bose 10-speaker Centerpoint surround audio system with Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium
- 17.7-inch diagonal advanced color LCD display with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Max Trailering Package with integrated trailer brake controller and extra capacity cooling
- Heated steering wheel with power adjustment and memory settings
- LED animated headlamps and tailamps with auto high-beam functionality
- Google built-in navigation with wireless phone charging capability
- 20-inch bright machined aluminum wheels with premium suspension
- Third-row 60/40 power split-folding bench seats for maximum versatility
- Z71 off-road features including hill descent control and 2-speed active electronic transfer case
- Front LED fog lamps and rear parking camera with hitch view technology
- Heated power-adjustable mirrors with driver-side auto-dimming
- Eight-way power driver and passenger seat adjusters with lumbar support
- OnStar and Chevrolet connected services with emergency communication system

The EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission delivers capable performance whether you're navigating city streets or tackling remote terrain. The 4WD system with hill descent control ensures confidence in any driving condition, while the Max Trailering Package provides the equipment necessary for serious towing responsibilities.

Inside, the Comfort Package elevates everyday driving with heated front and rear seats, sophisticated leather-appointed trim, and an advanced climate control system featuring rear air conditioning. The expansive panoramic sunroof floods the cabin with natural light, creating an open and inviting atmosphere for all passengers. The intuitive Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium system integrates seamlessly with your devices through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity.

The three-row seating arrangement accommodates up to eight passengers comfortably, with power-folding second and third-row benches that make accessing the cargo area effortless. Heated outboard seats in the second row provide added comfort during colder months, while the flexible seating configurations adapt to your lifestyle demands.

This Z71 stands apart with its aggressive styling elements including the front high-approach angle fascia, red recovery hooks, and tubular assist steps. The thoughtful exterior design combines function with rugged aesthetics, while the dual exhaust system contributes to a commanding presence on the road.

This 2025 Ford F-150 Tremor represents a commanding presence on any road, engineered to handle demanding tasks while delivering refined comfort and capability. The striking black exterior paired with premium 18-inch alloy wheels emphasizes its purposeful design, while the factory-backed balance of warranty ensures your investment is protected from day one.

- 5.0L V8 Engine with 10-Speed Automatic Transmission
- 4WD with 2-Speed Automatic AWD and Mechanical Locking Capability
- Lifetime Powertrain Protection
- Premium B&O Unleashed Sound System with 14 Speakers
- Leather Seats with Unique Tremor Trim Design
- Power Tailgate with Tailgate Step and Work Surface
- Tough Bed Spray-In Bedliner
- Navigation System with Connected Navigation
- Heads-Up Display
- Wireless Charging and Mobile Office Package
- Universal Garage Door Opener
- Power Glass Heated Sideview Mirrors with Auto-Dimming
- Heated Steering Wheel and 2nd Row Heated Seats
- Integrated Trailer Brake Controller with Tow/Haul Package

Under the hood, the potent 5.0L V8 combines with the smooth 10-Speed Automatic transmission to deliver real-world performance when you need it. The two-speed automatic AWD with mechanical locking 4WD provides the traction required for challenging terrain, while the front axle with Torsen differential ensures responsive handling in varied conditions. You'll achieve 17 mpg in the city and 22 mpg on the highway, balancing capability with practical fuel economy.

The cabin reflects Ford's commitment to functional luxury. The Tremor leather-trimmed bucket seats provide both support and comfort during long hauls, while the heated front seats and heated steering wheel add genuine utility during cooler months. The heads-up display keeps critical information visible without diverting your attention, and the connected navigation system ensures you'll reach your destination with confidence. The B&O Unleashed sound system with 14 speakers delivers a premium audio experience that makes every drive more enjoyable.

This truck's workspace is thoughtfully designed for those who work from their vehicle. The mobile office package includes a console worksurface and partitioned lockable rear storage, keeping your essentials organized and secure. The power-adjustable pedals with memory accommodate different drivers, while the power tailgate with integrated work surface transforms the truck bed into a functional platform. LED box lighting illuminates the bed for working in low-light conditions, and the tough spray-in bedliner protects your investment against wear and damage.

Safety and convenience features are intelligently integrated throughout. The backup camera, blind spot monitor, and rain-sensing wipers enhance your awareness and reduce driver fatigue. The SYNC 4 system with enhanced voice recognition keeps your hands on the wheel and eyes on the road. The universal garage door opener adds practical convenience to your daily routine.

This is a one-owner local trade with a clean CarFax report showing no accidents reported. With just over 24,000 miles, this F-150 Tremor has barely been broken in and remains fresh from the factory. The balance of the factory warranty provides continued peace of mind as you build your experiences with this capable machine.

The Lifetime Powertrain Certificate is valid only if oil changes are completed at Tri-County Ford every 5,000 miles and all manufacturer-recommended transmission services being performed at the required intervals. Failure to maintain these service requirements will result in cancellation or denial of coverage under the Lifetime Powertrain Certificate.

Safety remains central to this vehicle's design. The comprehensive airbag system, electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist work together to protect occupants. The rear backup camera aids parking and maneuvering, while advanced features like auto high-beam headlights and speed-sensing steering enhance overall driving safety.

The practical Towing Package and split-folding rear seats make this Telluride X-Line EX adaptable to your lifestyle needs. Whether you're hauling cargo or carrying passengers, the flexible interior configurations and ample space address diverse requirements. The power liftgate adds convenience for loading and unloading.

Come experience this capable, well-equipped three-row SUV and discover how it can enhance your daily driving and weekend adventures.
